summary: E-Power Inc., a Cayman holding company operating PRC graphite-anode and knowledge-platform businesses via subsidiaries and a VIE, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct placement to an accredited investor. It covers 229,097 Class A ordinary shares at $3.60 each and 292,393 pre-funded warrants priced at $3.60 less $0.0096, each exercisable at $0.0096 for one share. The prior close was $5.20. A 9.99% beneficial-ownership blocker applies. No advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch warrant-exercise overhang and the Form F-3 one-third public-float cap.
